text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool here, so I haven't confirmed the suite passes. I found each bug by reading the code against the tests.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it with `int(year)`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the `Emma` book, so I added it.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 but the lending policy and tests say 5. I set it to 5.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`). It now imports from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm. If anything still fails, send me the output and I'll fix it.
